senses.gloss:
लेशः [लिश्-घञ्]
1 A small
bit or portion, a particle, an atom,
a very small quantity; क्लेश (v. l.
स्वेद) लेशैरभिन्नं Ś. 2. 4; श्चमबारिलेशैः
Ku. 3. 38; so भाक्ति˚, गुण˚ &c.
--2
Smallness, littleness.
--3 A
measure of time (equal to two kalās).
--4 (In Rhet.) A figure of speech
which consists in representing what
is usually considered as an
advantage to be a disadvantage and vice
versa. It is thus defined in
R. G.: --गुणस्यानिष्टसाधनतया दोषत्वेन
दोषस्येष्टसाधनतया गुणत्वेन च वर्णनं लेशः; for
examples see ad loc. (Mammaṭa
appears to include this figure under
विशेष, see K. P. 10 under विशेष and
commentary).
--Comp.
--उक्त a.
only suggested, or hinted at,
insinuated.

लेष्टः [लिष्-तुन्] A cold, lump of
earth.
--Comp.
--भेदनः an
instrument for breaking clods.
लेसिकः A rider of an elephant.
